description: LDAP signing calibration profile for LDAP/389 SASL NTLM bind validation.

states.name: ldap_signing_not_required_invalid_credentials
states.why: LDAP returned invalidCredentials for synthetic NTLM Authenticate without a stronger-auth signal.
limitations: Invalid credentials alone do not prove LDAP signing is disabled or relayable.

states.name: ldap_signing_required_stronger_auth
states.why: LDAP returned a stronger-auth or confidentiality requirement in the bind response.
limitations: Result codes 8 and 13 indicate stronger protection requirements, but environment policy should be confirmed against domain controller settings.
